title: McFarlane Gold Label Marvel The Amazing Spider-Man Comic Covers #38 Figure NEW
descriptionText: This McFarlane Gold Label Marvel action figure features Spider-Man from "The Amazing Spider-Man" comic covers. Standing 7 inches tall, it is a 1st Edition boxed unit made of PVC, ABS, and plastic materials. The figure represents Spider-Man and comes in a ship vehicle type at a 1:10 scale. It is based on the Spider-Man franchise and the TV show, with a theme of Comic Book Heroes. The item was manufactured in 2024 in China.
